title: Dunnett's Test (vs. Control)
controlGroup: Control Group (exact label as in data)

help.title: Dunnett's Test (vs. Control)
help.body:
Description
Post-hoc pairwise comparison of each treatment group against a single designated control group, with multiplicity-adjusted p-values and confidence intervals. Used after a one-way ANOVA to identify which specific groups differ from control.

Important
Because BioStat Prime's existing ANOVA dialog cannot be extended with this post-hoc option, this dialog re-fits the one-way ANOVA internally using the same inputs before running Dunnett's comparisons. If you already ran ANOVA separately and it was not significant, interpret this post-hoc table with appropriate caution — an ANOVA summary is shown above the Dunnett's table for that context.

Requirements
• Group factor must have at least 2 levels (control + ≥1 treatment).
• "Control Group" must match one of the factor's level labels exactly, including case.

R functions used: stats::aov(), multcomp::glht() with mcp(Dunnett)
R Packages required: multcomp
